# is listed exactly once; a model absent from this file is unclassified and must not
# be automatically dispatched.  mentat is intentionally manual-only.
# pull_bytes (column 4) is the reviewed on-disk download size, in bytes, of a
# LOCALLY-PROVISIONED model.  It is blank for every model that is not pulled onto a
# host's Ollama store, and REQUIRED on the `local` routing default before the sysop
# `local-model` provisioning op will pull it: a blank/missing size fails that op
# closed before any network or disk activity (designs/sysop-local-model.md,
# scripts/jobs/{sysop.sh,pull-local-model.sh}).  Column readers (model_dispatch_tier,
# job_tier, tier_model_for_provider in common.sh) read a throwaway fourth field so
